part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"reallocate a fixed number of member-forecasts across (dates x members) to minimize the standard error of the slope of skill vs log N, rather than maximizing members on few dates","reason":"Reallocates compute across dates vs members and measures slope standard error; compute then buys independent verification dates, new information, not redundant draws."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"fit the score's a + b/N law from nested subsamples of a few hundred members and extrapolate the N-infinity asymptote directly, instead of buying the curve point by point with full-fidelity members","reason":"Changes what is measured: extrapolated N-infinity asymptote from an a + b/N fit; compute buys the asymptote and savings buy new dates/diversity."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"a group-sequential test that adds members in batches of 50 and stops as soon as the confidence interval on the skill gain versus the 50-member baseline excludes the decision threshold in either direction","reason":"Reorders computation as adaptive sequential batches aimed at a binary decision; freed compute buys more dates or diversity, not redundant members."}]}
